calls.reason: The court order establishes copyrighted-book training and pirated library acquisition, but identifies none of Marcus's books. It cannot establish his personal allegation or the full breadth claimed.

The CAIS statement and personal essays establish repeated catastrophic warnings. The financing announcements do not connect those warnings to fundraising; Marcus's characterization remains rhetorical.

Anthropic documents military deployment, and the Guardian reports continued use after the dispute. Neither adequately establishes targeting before the dispute; consent and assistance are expressly hedged.

Bloomberg's Minab reporting supports concern about overreliance on AI, but the full investigation remains unreleased and accounts differ. The packet does not clearly establish both overload and overtrust or inevitable errors.

AgentDyn documents security difficulties, while AgentSentry reports bounded successes. Anthropic's compiler experiment shows substantial costs and useful results; the packet does not settle broad expense and reliability claims.
The forecast runs to March 2036. WHO's historical statistics and Life Biosciences' early eye-treatment trial neither demonstrate doubled lifespan nor decide whether it will occur by then.
